title: Fair and Argumentative Language Modeling for Computational Argumentation

bias_targets.target: Sexual orientation and gender identity bias (Queerphobia)
bias_targets.methodology: Calculating Language Model Bias (LMB) scores by comparing the model's perplexity on human-annotated, stereotypically biased argumentative sentences versus counter-stereotypical sentences generated through counterfactual term substitution (e.g., replacing 'gay' with 'straight').
